Both independent bare controls are separate real HTML forms in the same browser, with matching current/default native values and matching disabled state for the preview case. They are outside the bound Form root; only synthetic default action uses this oracle.

Local prepare compares its numeric result to actual bare native content, keeps fixed dispatch/cancel expectations and in-dispatch values, and additionally requires unchanged markup/defaults. Paused input/change must remain unformatted at1900, proving reset did not resume automatic ownership.
No engine branches, skipped cases, deleted registrations, retries, timeout changes or production fixes are introduced. Original failures and native diagnostic remain independent historical evidence.
